clips.title: The story
paras: The Captured Mountaineer is an Ironforge dwarf held prisoner in the basement of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Bound and guarded by the Forsaken, he serves as an unwilling subject for the Royal Apothecary Society's grim experiments.

Tucked away beneath the floorboards of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, this Ironforge Mountaineer sits captive far from the safety of Khaz Modan. While patrons drink above, the Royal Apothecary Society puts him to work as an unwitting test subject for their concoctions. Apothecary Johaan and his peers test the lethal potency of their developing plague against living Alliance physiology, using the prisoner to gauge how well their toxins bring a swift and agonizing end to the living.
